name: A Visitor From Westward Realms: The Flavor of Freedom
description: A certain person from Sumeru is currently discussing something with Sara...

dialogs.content: Why, hello there! Are you talking about stuff to eat?
Hello, Sara, Nazafarin.
Ah, we meet again, you two. Indeed, one might say that our conversation did concern food, but... *sigh*
What happened? Don't worry, you can tell us. Maybe we can even help!
#If it's about food, we'll definitely help! Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}?
Will work for good food!
Ah, by Lesser Lord Kusanali, the two of you are as warm-hearted as ever!
So this is the issue. After you rescued me previously, I returned to Sumeru and wrote a report about the condiment market in Liyue.
Unexpectedly, I was approached by Lord Sangemah Bay, who expressed interest in purchasing the condiments that were the results of my research.
This most charitable merchant even offered to support any further research on my part! Ah, such good fortune! I signed right away, if you must know...
I then sent my dear friend Parvaneh a letter regarding this, and she gave me her full support.
So you're here in Mondstadt to start research into condiments?
That is precisely right, my good Paimon. In truth, I should've already begun this research, but...
Nazafarin wants to work with us by adding her secret condiments to our dishes and letting our customers try them.
However, we have restaurant standards that we must maintain, lest we face complaints from long-time customers, so we can't take her up on that offer.
*sigh* We've actually been having this chat for a while now, but we haven't been able to come up with any better ideas.
I've been thinking that perhaps we could ask Jean to help. I'm sure she could find the best solution to this problem!
Seriously!? Jean's super busy all the time, you know! So, uh, could we not make her come down just for this? We'll help out!
Aha, you see, what did I say? The two of you are Nazafarin's saviors, as always!
Right, then, there's no time to lose. Please, take this pot with you.
We shall do it as we did previously. We will make the condiments, add them to dishes, and invite your friends to try them!
Hehe. That's right, we'll do it just like before. Paimon volunteers to be the first taste-tester, by the way!
Eh, we'll do this for Paimon, I guess.
Hello there. And you are...
Ah, by Lesser Lord Kusanali! Do you not recognize me anymore?
Perhaps my presence is too weak, like a speck of dust that might be blown away by a gust at any time...
But I, for my part, remember your great deed in helping me develop seasonings and inviting all and sundry to try them!
